questions.question: A planner has 7 workers (rows) and 4 jobs (columns), with costs $c_{ij}$, and each job needs one worker. How should the cost table be made square?
options: 10 by 4, adding 3 dummy worker rows of zeros
7 by 7, adding 3 dummy job columns of zeros
4 by 4, dropping the 3 costliest workers
7 by 7, adding 3 dummy job columns of large cost

questions.question: A factory has 4 machines and 6 jobs; each machine can do one job, and leaving a job undone has no penalty. After the table is made square with dummies, what does every complete solution imply?
options: No job stays undone
Two machines stay idle
Two jobs are done twice
Two jobs stay undone

questions.question: Agents $C_1,\dots,C_4$ and tasks $T_1,T_2$ have costs $C_1$: 3, 9; $C_2$: 4, 5; $C_3$: 8, 6; $C_4$: 9, 4 (for $T_1$, $T_2$). Two dummy tasks with zero costs make the table square. What is the minimum total cost?

Agents $A_1,A_2,A_3$ and tasks $T_1,T_2$ have costs $A_1$: 7, 4; $A_2$: 5, 8; $A_3$: 6, 3 (for $T_1$, $T_2$). Each task needs one agent and each agent does at most one task, so a dummy task with zero costs is added. If agent $A_1$ is not allowed to stay idle, what is the best plan?
options: $A_3$ idle; $A_1$ on $T_2$, $A_2$ on $T_1$; total 9
$A_2$ idle; $A_1$ on $T_2$, $A_3$ on $T_1$; total 10
$A_1$ idle; $A_2$ on $T_1$, $A_3$ on $T_2$; total 8
$A_3$ idle; $A_1$ on $T_1$, $A_2$ on $T_2$; total 15

questions.question: Agents $A_1,A_2,A_3$ and tasks $T_1,T_2$ have costs $A_1$: 7, 4; $A_2$: 5, 8; $A_3$: 6, 3 (for $T_1$, $T_2$). Each task needs one agent and each agent does at most one task. A dummy task with zero costs is added and the square problem is solved. Which statement about the costs of the optimal real assignments is correct?
options: They equal the square optimum, since dummy entries add 0
They are the square optimum minus the idle agent's costs
They exceed the square optimum by the dummy costs
They are the square optimum divided over the three agents

questions.question: Five agents and three tasks are squared with two dummy task columns $X_1,X_2$, all zero. In an optimal solution agents $A_4$ and $A_5$ take $X_1$ and $X_2$. Does it matter which of them gets $X_1$?
options: Yes: $X_1$ marks the agent that is idle first
Yes: only one of the swaps is an optimal solution
No: swapping them gives the same real plan and total
No: dummy columns are removed before solving
